sessions.summary: Designed and implemented branded failwhale error pages for the marquee server to replace ugly JSON error responses. Decided to bake static HTML failwhale pages into the server binary using include_str! for reliability (survives S3 outages), while keeping separate product/marketing pages as un-harvested posts. Selected the 'Lost Signal' design with server-injected status codes (404/503/403) rendered into the page template, maintaining no-unsafe-eval CSP compliance.

sessions.summary: Analyzed divergence between global Severity Matrix (P1–P4, impact + notification-driven) and BAO team's BAOOC scale (P0–P4, response-time SLA-driven). Identified five substantive gaps: P4 means opposite things (triage state vs. known-trivial), global scale encodes paging posture (24/7 vs. work-hours boundary) while BAO doesn't, BAO factors rate-of-worsening into severity while global doesn't, BAO has no true 24/7 tier, and they assign severity at different lifecycle points (before vs. after confirmation). Recommended reconciliation focus on P4 definition, paging as a severity dimension, and impact vs. trajectory framing.

sessions.title: Update CI and release workflows for prod marquee
sessions.first-prompt: we have recently enabled prod marquee.internal.tatari.dev. Now we need to switch up the ci and release workflows. maybe just release. please investigate and advise
sessions.summary: Investigated and resolved a critical prod auto-deploy bug in marquee's CI/release pipeline. Prod marquee (running on apps-1 cluster via internal.tatari.dev) was silently enrolled in continuous deployment on every merge to main because the continuous dispatch sent an empty environments filter, matching all clusters with overlays. Implemented a two-part fix: (1) added `release-strategy: semver` to catalog-info.yaml to scope continuous dispatch to non-prod clusters only; (2) rewrote release.yml from 217 to 79 lines, replacing hand-rolled Rust build jobs with tatari-tv/github-actions#641 reusables (rust-cli-release.yml@v5 for CLI + platform-promote-prod.yml@v5 for prod), which promotes the test-validated digest to prod on v* tags rather than rebuilding. Updated deploy documentation across AGENTS.md, docs/deploy.md, and docs/backstage.md to reflect the new tag-driven prod promotion path.
